name: chemical-review
description: Five composable, evidence-governed chemistry skills plus an optional Markdown-to-DOCX publication projection.

interface.shortDescription: Iteratively develop a critical chemical literature review.
interface.longDescription: A lightweight set of five composable Markdown-first skills for shaping, researching, building a generalized chemical judgment Framework, drafting, and discussing a critical chemical literature review, plus an optional Publication projection to journal-readable Markdown and DOCX. The researcher keeps scientific judgement; the plugin does not claim validity or journal acceptance.
defaultPrompt: Use $chemical-review-intent to define and confirm a chemistry review brief.
Use $chemical-review-research with its preflight, discovery, and evidence Markdown companions to make the evidence route visible.
Use $chemical-review-framework after Research to build an evidence matrix, judgment-changing cases, comparison map, and bounded chemical judgments.
Use $chemical-review-synthesis and $chemical-review-qa to discuss one draft, independent observations, and the next revision in Markdown.
Use $chemical-review-publication on an approved draft to produce a clean journal-manuscript.md and journal-manuscript.docx projection.
